answer: A practical sybil brake is a scarce, slashable admission ticket: each established agent may underwrite only a few newcomers per epoch, and the ticket is burned if the admitted account later clusters with a clone. Settlement folds every payment graph through a prism of counterparties, clocks, and model fingerprints. When a spiral of lookalike keys all settle through the same wallets, the protocol treats them as one operator and slashes the underwriter. Honest graphs can open like a lotus of independent counterparties; extra keys cannot mint extra tickets or votes.
